power_budget_mA.note: Only one external power branch or serial branch enabled. Fault limit does not grant USB current: selected downstream device must respect100mA before configuration and descriptor budget thereafter; leave adapter overhead below the upstream allowance. Whole assembly suspend current requires measurement.

limitations: HP39gs special UART mating pinout not verified; HP50g evidence is not proof for39gs. Existing native USB is separate.
HP50g closed-port RX contention reduced by open-drain TX; wake/close behavior and signal thresholds require bench validation.
Nspire dock pinout and voltage vary by model; generic AUX is3.3V only and pin4 NC.
USB-A is downstream when upstream host supplies power and software; no independent host controller or battery.
Serial COM support is calculator/model/software specific; CH343 does not make every Casio official application support serial.
Selected external device total plus adapter overhead must fit USB host allowance; TPS current limit is fault protection, not a charging or current entitlement.
Suspend current, inrush, USB480Mbps eye, and hot-plug behavior require hardware measurements. Change selector with upstream unplugged.
Firmware redistribution, licenses and VID/PID authorization require explicit review; preserve original compatible firmware only within authorized use.
All actual EDA footprint/symbol mappings and current stock must be cross-checked before fabrication; real passive supplier candidates are now populated.
topology: one calculator selected at a time; CH444G USB2 mux, no hub

mode_switch.change_policy: Unplug upstream USB before changing mode. Nonshorting contact and diode blanking do not prove hot-switch sequencing across two mechanically skewed poles.

programming_header.J9: EEPROM SCL bridge; fitted normal, open ROM recovery
programming_header.J10: EEPROM WP ground shunt; open protected, fitted writable
programming_header.external_isolation: USB unplugged, remove R23 and R25, open J9; use3.3V programmer, readback, restore with power removed

placement_notes: Actual JLCEDA footprint fullBBox in mil converted to mm, rotated and checked with0.15mm envelope margin; no same-side envelope collisions or radius3mm mounting keepout violations. J1/J2 connector fronts intentionally extend beyond edge. DNP wire/program headers use pad envelopes. This is not copper DRC. Test pads are bottom PCB-only.

placement_validation.scope: Conservative component fullBBox/pad-only envelopes. Not copper DRC or SI verification.

revision_note: r7 replaces vertical J2 C718032 with right-angle SHOU HAN AF 10.0 HC6.3 C456017 at40,4.074980mm,rotation0. Pins1-4 drill centers are unchanged; separate shield pins5 and6 both GND. Other placements, all fixed USB/GND copper and prior TP6 r6 move are retained. Candidate autorouter trace410 must be rerouted for new left shield.
